subject.title: 🦞 Tracking: Onboard the channels & providers I use

question: Should completion of this onboarding epic continue to require the security-sensitive connect-options capability tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/766?
rationale: That child adds OAuth and pre/post connection-script configuration rather than only repairing established wizard behavior, so repository evidence cannot determine whether it should block this epic.

options.title: Split connect options
options.body: Keep this epic focused on reliable existing channel/provider onboarding and track the new direct-connect capability independently.

options.title: Keep full scope
options.body: Require the connect-options capability and its security review before this epic can close.

recommendation.title: Split connect options
recommendation.body: Keep this epic focused on reliable existing channel/provider onboarding and track the new direct-connect capability independently.

likelyOwner.reason: This person defined the epic scope and included the connect-options request in its completion checklist.
